parameters.query:
INSERT INTO sdlc.ai_failures
    (failure_type, source, message, log_excerpt, fixable_by_ai, resolved,
     created_at, metadata, branch, git_hub_run_id, git_hub_job_id, commit_sha, workflow_name)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, false, NOW(), $6::jsonb, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11)
ON CONFLICT (git_hub_run_id, git_hub_job_id, failure_type)
WHERE git_hub_run_id IS NOT NULL AND git_hub_job_id IS NOT NULL
DO NOTHING

setup: 1. n8n UI > Settings > Credentials > 'GitHub PAT' (HTTP Header Auth, Authorization: Bearer ghp_...)
2. n8n UI > Settings > Credentials > 'SDLC PostgreSQL' (Host: postgres, Port: 5432, DB: platforma_sdlc, User: platforma)
3. n8n UI > Workflows > Import from file > .n8n/workflows/github-failure-monitor.json
cursor: 커서 기반 폴링: n8n Static Data에 last_checked_at 저장 → 폴링 간 상태 유지
기본값: 첫 실행 시 24시간 전 (노트북 재시작 후에도 과거 실패 소급 처리)
낙관적 갱신: 실행 시작 시 커서 즉시 갱신 → ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING으로 중복 INSERT 방어
